<thought>Based on the mass spectrum (M+H = 127.0997) the neutral molecular formula is C₇H₁₂NO. The ¹H NMR shows three singlets integrating to 3 H, 6 H and 3 H, indicating three distinct methyl groups with no neighboring protons. A structure that fits C₇H₁₂NO and contains a gem‑dimethyl group (6 H), an N‑methyl (3 H) and an acetyl methyl (3 H) is N‑methyl‑2‑methyl‑2‑propionamide, whose SMILES is **CC(C)(C)C(=O)NC**. This SMILES corresponds to the formula C₇H₁₂NO and the expected NMR pattern.</thought>
<final_answer>CC(C)(C)C(=O)NC</final_answer>
